thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU pool eu-west-1/low-lat queue growth > 90% for 10m — autoscale failing to add nodes (rate-limited). Severity: P2.

Priyanka: acked. I'm oncall — pulling up dashboards.

Jon: on it too, checking autoscaler logs and provider error traces.

Marta: tagging product ops for customer impact check: @Ava can you surface any high-traffic customers in eu-west-1 right now?

Ava: @Marta looking — two customers with high sustained QPS: billing-service-prod and chat-widget. Billing-prod has 4 active routes hitting long-context models.

Priyanka: initial hypothesis: provider hitting soft API rate limits for instance creation, autoscaler retries backing off -> queue grows -> runtime throttles requests.

Jon: confirming from controller logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:07Z autoscaler ERROR: Provisioning failed: 429 Too Many Requests
2026-03-15T14:12:35Z autoscaler WARN: backoff increased to 120s
2026-03-15T14:13:02Z queue INFO: avg_wait_time 1750ms, inflight 42, queued 230
```

Sam: is there a recent config change to min/max pools? could be a misconfigured cap.

Priyanka: checking config now — no recent change to min, but I see a new burst cap (max_per_region=20) set yesterday by rollout 2026-03-14T09:00. That should be fine. However, we have a per-account limit from cloud provider of 18 gpus in eu-west for this account. Autoscaler expects to reach 20 and keeps retrying.

Marta: ok, that mismatch explains provisioning 429s. Action: reduce desired to 18 and allow fallback to compatible quantized variants.

Jon: executing temporary mitigation — scaling down desired and enabling fallback routing for low-priority queues. Running commands:
```
# set desired to provider limit
redwoodctl pools update eu-west-1/low-lat --desired-instances=18
# enable fallback model variant
redwoodctl routes update --route=chat-widget --fallback-model=llama-quant-4bit
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-15T14:16:03 triggered for route chat-widget (canary).

Ava: notifying customers: billing-service-prod experiencing degraded latency for about 15 minutes; flagged to Billing SEs. chat-widget will be routed to quantized variant, expect small quality regression.

Priyanka: monitoring queue after adjustments.

Jon: queue size dropping: queued 230 -> 90 in 3m. avg_wait_time -> 600ms. No more 429s from provider.

Sam: good. Need to document root cause: autoscaler configured to assume higher provider quota; provider-side quota not checked at rollout time.

Marta: creating temporary pager rule to alert when autoscaler receives consecutive 429s > 3 in 5m.

Incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled 2026-03-15T16:00Z. @Sam will take follow-up for postmortem.

Priyanka: mitigation checklist complete?
Sam: listing live mitigations: 1) lowered desired instances to provider quota, 2) enabled per-route fallback to quantized model for non-SLO routes, 3) triggered an immediate support ticket with cloud provider to request quota increase, 4) added alert for 429 streaks.

Ava: customers notified — billing SE acknowledged. No escalations yet.

Jon: please snapshot autoscaler state and deploy logs to incident S3:
```
aws s3 cp /var/log/autoscaler/2026-03-15/ s3://redwood-incidents/2009991234/ --recursive
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide > s3://redwood-incidents/2009991234/pods.txt
```

Priyanka: done — uploaded.

Marta: moving to follow-up: postmortem owners and action items. Priyanka and Sam to co-author. Jon to provide logs and timeline. Ava to collate customer impact notes and replies from SEs.

Sam: initial blameless summary for postmortem: "Autoscaler attempted to provision beyond cloud provider quota after a recent rollout changed desired max; 429 responses caused exponential backoff and queue growth, leading to request throttling for non-critical routes. Temporary mitigations restored service by aligning desired capacity with provider limits and enabling model fallbacks."

Priyanka: priority action items (owner, ETA):
- Validate provider quotas during rollout (Sam, 2026-03-22)
- Add autoscaler 429-streak detection and automated soft-cap fallback (Jon, 2026-03-29)
- Improve runbook for queue surge (Marta, 2026-03-20)
- Seek provider quota increase and document limits per-region (Ava, 2026-03-18)

Ops Runbook: Reminder: schedule a canary for any future pool max increase and run quota check as part of rollout CI.

Priyanka: marking incident P2 resolved — queue and latency returned to baseline; we'll run postmortem next week. Thanks all. :clap:

Ava: leaving notes for customers and will follow up with SE replies.

Jon: leaving a short runbook patch in PR for autoscaler backoff handling now.

Sam: oncall handoff to @Sam at 16:00 as noted. Closing thread and will open postmortem doc under /incidents/postmortems once draft is ready.

incident-bot: Incident 2009991234 status => mitigated. Metrics: peak queued=254, max_wait=2.1s, duration=45m.
